name: Kebabs
description: Tender chicken or paneer pieces cooked in a tandoor with khoya and jaggery. Served with a sweet and spicy jaggery-chilli dip.

name: Charred cauliflower
description: Smoky charred cauliflower florets served on a rich sesame-poppy seed gravy, finished with a flavorful ghee-chilli drizzle.

name: Grilled king prawns
description: Succulent grilled scampi seasoned with a secret blend of spices and tangy mango dust. Served with delicate spherified pearls.

name: Sesame and green mango chicken
description: A zesty chicken curry cooked with raw green mango and black sesame. Topped with a fresh mango and chilli flake relish.

name: Lamb stew
description: Traditional slow-cooked mutton in a rich Bengal-style gravy with crispy beresta. Served with a side of fragrant steamed rice.

name: Creamy coconut prawn curry
description: Jumbo scampi simmered in a silky Cambodian-style coconut amok gravy. Accompanied by a bowl of fluffy steamed rice.

name: Pineapple pudding
description: A unique and comforting dessert of ghee-roasted sonamoong daal paired with sweet, charred pineapple slices.

name: Bruschetta
description: Classic toasted sourdough topped with ripe heirloom tomatoes, garlic, fresh basil, and premium extra virgin olive oil.

name: Burratta
description: Creamy burrata cheese paired with pan-fried aubergine, artichoke hearts, and cherry tomatoes, finished with aromatic white truffle oil.

name: Spaghetti Aglio, Olio e Peperoncino
description: Al dente spaghetti tossed in a simple but bold sauce of garlic, red chilli, fresh parsley, and olive oil.

name: Penne Arrabbiata
description: A classic Italian favorite featuring penne in a spicy, garlic-infused tomato sauce, garnished with fresh garden parsley.

name: Mac and Cheese
description: Tender macaroni pasta enveloped in a rich, velvety, and intensely creamy blend of gourmet cheeses.

name: Funghi
description: A savory pizza topped with a variety of mushrooms, roasted garlic, tangy tomato sauce, and fresh fior di latte mozzarella.

name: Rucola e Formaggio di Capra
description: A fresh and tangy pizza with creamy goat cheese, peppery wild rocket, and a vibrant basil sauce base.

name: Pepperoni
description: A traditional favorite featuring spicy cured pepperoni, rich tomato sauce, and melted fior di latte mozzarella.

name: Rucola e Prosciutto di Parma
description: An elegant pizza topped with premium parma ham, fresh wild rocket, tomato sauce, and mozzarella.

name: Nduja
description: A spicy and bold pizza featuring soft Calabrian Nduja sausage, tomato sauce, and melted fior di latte mozzarella.

name: Mojito
description: A refreshing blend of white rum, fresh lime juice, mint leaves, and a touch of sugar, topped with sparkling soda water.

name: Jeera Rice
description: Aromatic long-grain basmati rice tempered with cumin seeds and pure ghee for a subtle, savory finish.

name: Butter Naan
description: Soft, pillow-like leavened bread baked to perfection in a tandoor oven and brushed with a generous layer of melted butter.

name: Tandoori Mayo
description: A creamy, smoky dipping sauce infused with traditional tandoori spices for a unique and bold flavor profile.
